", "relative_path": "sources/orchard_receipt.md", "heading": "Supplier invoice intake"}, {"snippet_id": "S2", "text": "
For invoices with complete intake details, the coordinator attaches the original invoice to the ledger record and routes the record to the budget owner named on the purchase order.", "relative_path": "sources/orchard_receipt.md", "heading": "Supplier invoice intake"}, {"snippet_id": "S3", "text": "The budget owner compares the invoice amount with the purchase order and confirms that the goods or services were received. If both checks pass, the owner marks the invoice Approved in the ledger. A mismatch is sent back to accounts payable for investigation, rather than being approved automatically.
", "relative_path": "sources/orchard_approval.md", "heading": "Budget approval"}, {"snippet_id": "S4", "text": "
Approval is the budget owner's decision. ", "relative_path": "sources/orchard_payment.md", "heading": "Payment run"}, {"snippet_id": "S6", "text": "
